issue.body:
### Description

This doesn't seem to happen when `noreply` emails are used.
When a different git `name`'s used from the account's `username`, the `Author` link, username, and pfp in `/commits`, link to the wrong gitea account. When you click on the commit sha, and view the commit directly, it links correctly as expected, this only seem so happen for non-`noreply` emails, this doesn't happen on GitHub and GitLab. The git name's expected, but the link to the username, and pfp aren't.


### Gitea Version

1.23.7

### Can you reproduce the bug on the Gitea demo site?

Used official site.

### Log Gist

_No response_

### Screenshots

https://gitea.com/brian6932/test/commits/branch/main
![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f1969c4d-4695-463d-a3a6-8f1604a19945)
https://gitea.com/brian6932/test/commit/d84094141b494671a030136b747f847b67a23f22 works as expected.
![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/30aa3373-0d10-4942-98c9-5ebed0b6edee)

Not my server.

Not my server.

Using https://gitea.com/.

issue.body: When listing commits, Gitea attempts to retrieve the actual user based on the commit email. Querying users one by one from the database is inefficient. This PR optimizes the process by batch querying users by email, reducing the number of database queries.

1.24 nightly is ready and contains the fix (it will be 1.24.0 soon)

* https://dl.gitea.com/gitea/1.24-nightly/
* https://hub.docker.com/r/gitea/gitea/tags?name=1.24-nightly

This issue still exists in the 1.24 nightly release. It appears that the method for obtaining avatar and signature status differs between the commit list and commit info. The primary cause of this issue is that the Git email does not match the committer's email, yet the behavior remains inconsistent across the two pages. Tested on Gitea v1.24.0+rc0-51-g8defca6d39.
